name: Ewal Tempus Winter Theme
description: Ewal Spacemacs Modern theme using the tempus_winter built-in dark palette.
elispBefore: (unless (package-installed-p 'spacemacs-theme) (package-install 'spacemacs-theme)) (setq ewal-use-built-in-always-p t ewal-use-built-in-on-failure-p t ewal-dark-palette-p t ewal-built-in-palette "tempus_winter" ewal-json-file (expand-file-name "tempus_winter.json" (car load-path)))
